cd "/home/author/Documents/GitHub/repo\.campaign\sandbox\w3\git.history_rewrite-v8-178660635222468"
# Create an editor script that will be used for rebase
$scriptContent = @'
$file = $args[0]

git rebase -i ed67e0a~1
